family_grammar.scene_order: the records' own dependency order — parent node first, then the units in the order the records themselves derive: recognised structure (ontological), physical image (solar system), political expression (social/power), occlusion (deficiency), spectral enactments (Devil's chain, Christ's chain)
family_grammar.structure_staging: each scene's formations stage the unit's own declared structure: the four prepositions around the ground (self-identity), the sixfold row (ontological), sun + orbit ring + bodies (solar system), concentric work/play rings (social/power), the dimmed sun under a veil (deficiency), the chain links with contraction/attraction anchors (the two spectral chains)
family_grammar.character_line: the record's own function/parent-node line, compressed but never re-claimed

note: One scene per admitted unit; unit cross-references live in the source records' own [[links]] and are not duplicated as graph edges.
